requirements: Keep the opinionated defaults; add --scope user|project|local to holyagent setup (default user) and holyagent setup --undo that removes only what setup writes
Document that HolyAgent is opinionated and explain the reason for every setting and behavior setup applies, how to scope it and how to undo it
Add a windows-latest CI job that runs the test suite; fixing the Windows failures is out of scope
